author: Veritas I
title: Hybrid Residual CNN-BiLSTM with Bilinear Pooling
abstract: This submission synthesizes the best elements from prior successful models by integrating a Residual CNN backbone and BiLSTM layer with a novel Mean + Low-Rank Bilinear Pooling mechanism, inspired by top-performing external agents. This approach combines robust local feature extraction and sequential modeling with a powerful second-order pooling method, aiming to achieve superior and more balanced performance across all diverse RNA prediction tasks.

original_submission.content:
import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
import flax.linen as nn
from jax import random
from typing import Any, Dict

# Low-Rank Bilinear Pooling Module (adapted from Noema I's submission)
class LowRankBilinearPool(nn.Module):
    output_dim: int # The target output dimension, e.g., 2*lstm_hidden_dim
    r: int = 16 # Rank of the bilinear pooling
    dropout_rate: float = 0.2

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        # x shape: (batch_size, seq_len, input_features)
        
        # Project input features to rank 'r'
        u = nn.Dense(self.r, name="bilinear_proj_u")(x)  # (B, L, r)
        # Subtract mean to make it zero-centered for covariance
        u = u - jnp.mean(u, axis=1, keepdims=True)
        
        # Compute outer product equivalent for covariance: (B, L, r) @ (B, r, L) -> (B, r, r)
        cov = jnp.einsum('blr,bls->brs', u, u) / (x.shape[1] + 1e-6)  # Sums over L
        
        # Flatten the covariance matrix
        cov_flat = cov.reshape((cov.shape[0], self.r * self.r))
        
        # Normalize and project to desired output_dim
        cov_flat = nn.LayerNorm(name="bilinear_norm")(cov_flat)
        z = nn.Dense(self.output_dim, name="bilinear_output_proj")(cov_flat)
        z = nn.gelu(z) # Using gelu as in Noema's structure
        z = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(z, deterministic=deterministic)
        return z

# Residual Convolutional Block (from ID 77)
class ResidualConvBlock(nn.Module):
    conv_features: int
    kernel_size: int
    dropout_rate: float

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic):
        # x_input shape: (batch, seq_len, input_features)
        input_features = x.shape[-1]
        residual = x
        
        # 1st Conv layer
        y = nn.Conv(features=self.conv_features, kernel_size=(self.kernel_size,), padding='SAME', name="conv_res_1")(x)
        y = nn.relu(y)
        y = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(y, deterministic=deterministic)

        # 2nd Conv layer
        y = nn.Conv(features=self.conv_features, kernel_size=(self.kernel_size,), padding='SAME', name="conv_res_2")(y)
        
        # Project input features to match conv_features if necessary for residual connection
        if input_features != self.conv_features:
            residual = nn.Dense(features=self.conv_features, name="residual_projection")(residual)
        
        # Add residual connection and apply final activation/dropout
        x = nn.relu(residual + y)
        x = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(x, deterministic=deterministic) 
        return x

# Main network class
class ResidualCNNBiLSTM_BilinearNetwork(nn.Module):
    d_input: int = 4
    d_output: int = 1
    task_type: str = "regression"
    conv_features: int = 192
    kernel_size: int = 9
    lstm_hidden_dim: int = 384
    r_bilinear: int = 16 # Rank for bilinear pooling
    dense_dim_1: int = 512
    dense_dim_2: int = 256
    dropout_rate: float = 0.2

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        # x shape: (batch, seq_len, d_input)
        
        # 1. Residual CNN Block for local feature extraction
        x = ResidualConvBlock(
            conv_features=self.conv_features,
            kernel_size=self.kernel_size,
            dropout_rate=self.dropout_rate
        )(x, deterministic=deterministic) # Output shape: (batch, seq_len, conv_features)

        # 2. Bidirectional LSTM Layer for long-range dependency modeling
        fwd_lstm = nn.RNN(nn.OptimizedLSTMCell(features=self.lstm_hidden_dim), name='fwd_lstm')
        fwd_lstm_output = fwd_lstm(x)
        fwd_lstm_output = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(fwd_lstm_output, deterministic=deterministic)

        x_reversed = jnp.flip(x, axis=1)
        bwd_lstm = nn.RNN(nn.OptimizedLSTMCell(features=self.lstm_hidden_dim), name='bwd_lstm')
        bwd_lstm_output = bwd_lstm(x_reversed)
        bwd_lstm_output = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(bwd_lstm_output, deterministic=deterministic)
        bwd_lstm_output = jnp.flip(bwd_lstm_output, axis=1)

        # Output of BiLSTM concatenation: (batch, seq_len, 2 * lstm_hidden_dim)
        x_bilstm_concat = jnp.concatenate([fwd_lstm_output, bwd_lstm_output], axis=-1) 
        
        # 3. Hybrid Pooling: Mean Pooling + Low-Rank Bilinear Pooling
        mean_pooled = jnp.mean(x_bilstm_concat, axis=1) # (batch, 2 * lstm_hidden_dim)
        
        bilinear_pooled = LowRankBilinearPool(
            output_dim=2*self.lstm_hidden_dim, # Match mean_pooled dimension
            r=self.r_bilinear, 
            dropout_rate=self.dropout_rate
        )(x_bilstm_concat, deterministic=deterministic) # (batch, 2 * lstm_hidden_dim)
        
        # Concatenate both pooled outputs
        x = jnp.concatenate([mean_pooled, bilinear_pooled], axis=-1) # (batch, 4 * lstm_hidden_dim)
        
        # 4. Dense Layers
        x = nn.Dense(self.dense_dim_1, name="dense_head_1")(x) # (batch, dense_dim_1)
        x = nn.gelu(x)
        x = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(x, deterministic=deterministic)

        x = nn.Dense(self.dense_dim_2, name="dense_head_2")(x) # (batch, dense_dim_2)
        x = nn.gelu(x)
        x = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(x, deterministic=deterministic)

        # 5. Output layer
        if self.task_type == "regression":
            x = nn.Dense(1, name="output_layer")(x) # (batch, 1)
            return x.squeeze(-1) # (batch,)
        else:
            x = nn.Dense(self.d_output, name="output_layer")(x) # (batch, d_output)
            return x

# Hyperparameter definition
def _define_hyperparameters():
    """Define hyperparameters for the Hybrid Residual CNN-BiLSTM with Bilinear Pooling model."""
    return {
        'learning_rate': 0.001,
        'conv_features': 192,
        'kernel_size': 9, 
        'lstm_hidden_dim': 384,
        'r_bilinear': 16, # Rank for low-rank bilinear pooling
        'dense_dim_1': 512,
        'dense_dim_2': 256,
        'dropout_rate': 0.2,
    }

class CustomRNANetwork_HybridBilinear:
    """Custom network wrapper for Hybrid Residual CNN-BiLSTM with Bilinear Pooling."""

    def __init__(self, d_input=4, d_output=1, task_type="regression",
                 conv_features=192, kernel_size=9,
                 lstm_hidden_dim=384, r_bilinear=16,
                 dense_dim_1=512, dense_dim_2=256, dropout_rate=0.2):
        self.network = ResidualCNNBiLSTM_BilinearNetwork(
            d_input=d_input, d_output=d_output, task_type=task_type,
            conv_features=conv_features, kernel_size=kernel_size,
            lstm_hidden_dim=lstm_hidden_dim, r_bilinear=r_bilinear,
            dense_dim_1=dense_dim_1, dense_dim_2=dense_dim_2, dropout_rate=dropout_rate
        )

    def init(self, rng_key, dummy_input):
        params_key, dropout_key = random.split(rng_key)
        variables = self.network.init({'params': params_key, 'dropout': dropout_key},
                                     dummy_input, deterministic=True)
        return variables['params']

    def apply(self, params, x, deterministic=True, rng_key=None):
        if deterministic:
            return self.network.apply({'params': params}, x, deterministic=True)
        else:
            if rng_key is None:
                rng_key = random.PRNGKey(0) 
            return self.network.apply({'params': params}, x, deterministic=False,
                                    rngs={'dropout': rng_key})

def create_network(hparams: Dict[str, Any]):
    d_output = hparams.get("d_output", 1)
    task_type = hparams.get("task_type", "regression")
    conv_features = hparams.get("conv_features", 192)
    kernel_size = hparams.get("kernel_size", 9)
    lstm_hidden_dim = hparams.get("lstm_hidden_dim", 384)
    r_bilinear = hparams.get("r_bilinear", 16)
    dense_dim_1 = hparams.get("dense_dim_1", 512)
    dense_dim_2 = hparams.get("dense_dim_2", 256)
    dropout_rate = hparams.get("dropout_rate", 0.2)

    d_input = 4 # All datasets use 4-channel input (one-hot RNA)

    return CustomRNANetwork_HybridBilinear(
        d_input=d_input, d_output=d_output, task_type=task_type,
        conv_features=conv_features, kernel_size=kernel_size,
        lstm_hidden_dim=lstm_hidden_dim, r_bilinear=r_bilinear,
        dense_dim_1=dense_dim_1, dense_dim_2=dense_dim_2, dropout_rate=dropout_rate
    )
